name: Cosmos DB account
summary: Cosmos DB account using the SQL (Core) API, with databases and containers, Entra ID only data-plane RBAC and private access only.
useWhen: You need a globally distributed, low-latency NoSQL database
You need single-digit-millisecond reads and flexible schema, e.g. for a product catalog, user profiles or an agent's session store
avoidWhen: You need a relational database with joins and transactions across tables (use Azure SQL or SQL Managed Instance)
You need the MongoDB, Cassandra, Gremlin or Table API specifically (this module only wires the SQL/Core API databases and containers, though the underlying account resource supports the others)
